docs.title: Flask Todo App Documentation
docs.text: Welcome to the Flask Todo App documentation. This application is a modern task management system built with Flask, featuring OAuth authentication and Markdown support.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• User authentication (Local and OAuth)
  • Task management with priorities
  • Markdown support for task content
  • Responsive design
  • RESTful API

docs.title: Step-by-Step Installation
docs.text:
1. Clone the repository: 

    git clone https://github.com/yourusername/flask-todo-app
cd flask-todo-app

  2. Create virtual environment 

    python3 -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate  # On Windows: venv\Scripts\activate

docs.title: api/auth.md:
docs.text:
# Authentication API

## Login

Authenticate a user and receive an access token.

### Request

`POST /auth/login`

```json
{
    "username": "example_user",
    "password": "secure_password"
}

## Response 

```json
{
    "access_token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
    "token_type": "bearer"
}
